title: Insights into electric- and thermal-induced decomposition and gas evolution of silicone rubber through experiments and molecular simulations
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50337-50345
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07405C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jingwen Gong, Qi Zhao, Jingtao Huang, Zhuocheng Ye, Zihao Wang, Yidong Chen, Wei Gong
The degradation state of silicone rubber (SiR) under electric and thermal fields is investigated via gas-evolution analysis. Molecular simulation is utilized to validate experimental data and elucidate the fundamental chemical degradation pathways.
